name: @waronsaas/desktop
description: wOS Desktop: the contributor build environment. Electron main process owns processes, git and the filesystem; the renderer is sandboxed.

scripts.smoke: npm run bundle && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test/electron.test.ts
scripts.dist:mac: npm run bundle:release && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run bundle:release && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run bundle:release && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --publish never
